published_implementation.historical_relation: Public evidence payload migrated from the pre-neutral S3* function-specific record; S3* interpretation remains derived.

audit_loop: candidate PR generated for an issue
separate reviewer agent explores repository and patch
reviewer emits approve/reject decision plus structured feedback
rejected patch returns to the original PR generator for revision
revised patch is re-verified through SWE-bench
observations.revision_protocol: approved patches remain unchanged; rejected patches are revised by the original PR generator for the split; model failures fall back to the original patch
observations.publisher_conclusion: Agentic review continuously improves PRs through iterative review-revision and improves downstream issue resolution relative to one-shot generation and fixed-context review baselines.
